chunks: It is God who made the earth a dwelling for you, and the sky a vaulted roof, who fashioned you and gave you excellent form and provided you with clean and wholesome things. He is God, your Lord. So blessed be God, the Lord of all the worlds.

key_terms.قَرَاراً: a stable dwelling or place of rest

ai.seo_question: What are the four main blessings of God mentioned in this verse regarding creation and sustenance?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia supplications such as those in *Al-Sahifa al-Sajjadiyya*, emphasizes the divine attributes of *Al-Bani* (The Builder) and *Al-Musawwir* (The Fashioner), highlighting the intentional design of the cosmos and human physique. It serves as a theological foundation for recognizing God’s mercy through both structural stability (earth and sky) and biological perfection, urging believers to acknowledge these blessings as signs of the Lord of the Worlds.
